page.overview:
What is Giff?

The Giffs, pronounced with a hard G, also known as Eloids (as named by Eli Reynolds after himself) were an ancient, and potentially extinct extraterritorial species of unknown origin. The name was given them after the guttural noise one made while gesturing to itself in a recording.

Giffs were bipedal, with rubbery looking columnar legs which flowed into feet without visible ankles. Their skin was pinkish tan, slightly mottled, in places, with thatches of hair growing from their shoulders. They had devices affixed to its body on straps, but nothing that looked like clothing. Their upper bodies was barrel-like, their arms rubbery, their gripping digits not unlike tentacles, with six to a hand, prehensile enough to be opposable without a thumb. Their heads were cylindrical. They inhaled and exhaled through hundreds of tiny pores located on their torso.

They had red blood and were sexually dimorphic.

Giffs communicated at a high frequency that humans struggled to hear. They were vulnerable to human microorganisms and vice versa. They had little physical combat prowess.
